dialogue.text: This meat is good, but so is this.... Sausage is great.
dialogue.textjp: こっちの肉も旨いけど、こっちもいける...やっぱソーセージは王道だな

dialogue.text: I picked a set of foods at random, but there's nothing wrong with it! Yay!
dialogue.textjp: セットで売ってた材料適当に選んだけどハズレ無しだな！やりぃ！

dialogue.text: GF told me to eat vegetables the other day, so I'll make sure to eat them...
dialogue.textjp: 野菜も食べろってこの前ＧＦに言われたし、ちゃんと食べとくか...

dialogue.text: Speaking of which, what are those guys doing?
dialogue.textjp: そういえばあいつら何やってんだ？

dialogue.text: Hey, you guys don't eat--?
dialogue.textjp: おい食わないのかお前らーー

dialogue.text: YOU REALLY CAN'T BE FUCKIN' SERIOUS, YOU BASTARD! YOU HAVE NO SENSE OF STYLE!!
dialogue.textjp: テメェまじふざけんじゃねぇぞクソッたれ！！センスねぇにも程があんだろ！！

dialogue.text: HUH!? I'M TALKING TO YOU, YOU DAMN PIECE OF SHIT! I THINK A FISH ATE YOUR HEAD!?
dialogue.textjp: あぁ！？こっちのセリフだボケカス！頭ン中魚に食われたんじゃねぇのか！？

dialogue.text: YOU BOTH ARE DUMBASSES! YOU ARE PATHETIC AS YOUR DICK SIZE!
dialogue.textjp: どっちもどっちよこの租チン共！そのイチモツと同じくらいしょうもないわね！！

dialogue.text: HAAAAAH!?
dialogue.textjp: はぁぁああ！！？

dialogue.text: YOU'VE GOT TO BE KIDDING ME, YOU DAMN BITCH!
dialogue.textjp: てめぇふざけんじゃねぇクソアマ！！！

dialogue.text: DON'T MAKE BEEF YOU ASSHOLES!
dialogue.textjp: お前ら全員ふざけんじゃねぇ！！

dialogue.text: WHERE DO YOU THINK? THIS IS NOT YOUR TURF!
dialogue.textjp: ここどこだと思ってんだテメェらのいつもの庭じゃないんだぞ！？

dialogue.text: Ah!? It's because these guys don't know what they're talking about!
dialogue.textjp: あ！？こいつらが物分かり悪いからだろうが！

dialogue.text: I don't want to be told by a simple head who only talks about meat!
dialogue.textjp: 肉肉うるさい単純男に言われたくないわね！

dialogue.text: Now you know, BF! that it started with them, not me!
dialogue.textjp: 今のでわかっただろBF！事の発端はこいつらだ、俺は悪くねぇ！

dialogue.text: YOU ALL!!!!
dialogue.textjp: どっちもどっちだよ！！！！

dialogue.text: Of course BF is on my side! Right!?
dialogue.textjp: ＢＦは勿論私の味方よね！？

dialogue.text: Deja Vu!!!!
dialogue.textjp: デジャヴ！！！！！

dialogue.text: What kind of dummy brings a of sweets to a barbecue!?
dialogue.textjp: バーベキューにスイーツメインで持ち込む馬鹿が居るかよ！

dialogue.text: You too! Seafood is a choice like an old man!
dialogue.textjp: お前もだろ！！魚介とか渋いわジジィかよ！！

dialogue.text: You have now turned all seafood fans against you.
dialogue.textjp: お前は今全ての魚介ファンを敵に回した

dialogue.text: What's a seafood fan...
dialogue.textjp: 魚介ファンってなんだよ

dialogue.text: It's because you deny the king of the high road.
dialogue.textjp: 王道を否定するからだろ

dialogue.text: Meat is the princess of the barbecue world.
dialogue.textjp: 肉こそバーベキュー界のプリンセス

dialogue.text: I thought the expression there was king...
dialogue.textjp: そこはキングじゃないのかよ

dialogue.text: You're not popular because you make fun of sweets.
dialogue.textjp: スイーツを馬鹿にするからモテないのよアンタら

dialogue.text: Well that's undeniable.
dialogue.textjp: うーんそれは何も言えん
